notes.title: Patch v0.7.22.1104
notes.content:
Hello Farmers!

/!\ As usual, updates from Adarin Farm will [b]reset [/b]your current run as [b]new mechanics are added[/b]. Be sure to finish your current run before downloading the update.

[b]For this major patch, all progress is reset[/b].

Patch will be deployed on the 04/11/22 at around 9.00pm CET.

Thanks for your returns, improvements & bug fixes are mainly coming from player feedback.

[b]Global notes[/b]

Major changes have happened.

[list]
[*] Progress is now based on experience and levels to unlock new features/more powerful features. Every requests done is now giving experience. Skill tree has been removed and unlocks have been changed.
[*] 4 difficulties are available as meta progress.
[*] Gameplay loop is now based on the seeds you plant which raises a Fairy Slimes counter. Upon reaching maximum, you are able to choose a benefic spell which impact the whole run. Curses have been removed, field effects have been removed.
[*] Runes are now used to reroll Fairy Slimes Spells choice.
[*] UI have been totally revamp for more readability.
[/list]
Chill, relax and loot your way to victory!

UI have been totally revamp for more readability.

notes.title: New major patch coming on 4th of November 2022
notes.content:
Hello Farmers!

Major update will come on 4th of Nov revamping some of the current gameplay of Adarin Farm.

Some highlights:

[b]Fairy Slimes[/b]

Slimes are now your friends! They will cast a positive Spell that will drastically impact your run once you fullfill their needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/1b03fbbabbb4e39733e3fbad1871d6998c8b8df2.png[/img]

You will have to choose which one is the most accurate for your current run:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/23cd7401543cc117be2ac4984367b5293c594f4a.png[/img]

This will lead to tailored runs that will be different each time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/b3a81b33266905edebfc2067dd25919f5d3365cc.png[/img]

[b]Progression System[/b]

Progression System is now based on levels. Skill tree has been removed and mostly incorporated in Fairy Slimes mechanic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/92d33acf76542ae53c8f35c05ac34ff5c3322af3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/362a4ae9cbf187d6d08cb4786ad22df9c97d0fe8.png[/img]

By reaching new levels you will unlock more upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/482ae2b571b943160c55adb59115067e26ceacdd.png[/img]

Level selection has been simplified.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/b94efcf2f62fc46fd70b9af15a2023d6a1029b3e.png[/img]

Chill, relax and loot your way to victory!

Patch will be deployed on the 05/03/22 at around 9.00am CET.

Thanks for your returns, improvements & bug fixes are mainly coming from player feedback.

[b]Global notes[/b]

As requested by many people, now Hotkeys for seeds & farmers are coming to Adarin Farm. You can now use hotkey from 0-9 to plant seeds and assign farmer. One key pressed plants the seed while hovering a empty field and one key pressed while a seed is planted assigns a farmer. You can now plant fast! A future update will allow custom keybindings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/effb6fb393beb72d9e1fbf81c9111770396a140f.png[/img]


A new fertilizer effect is coming to Adarin Farm: the ability to improve seed effects of the planted seed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/d57fcd988fe2bdcc554f93cefad37d50d87ddddb.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a warning message while planting with no seed left.
[*] Added loading tip on hotkeys for seeds/farmers.
[*] Added a warning while trying to assign a farmer on a field with an already assigned farmer.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where different gradient of Orange where appearing in tooltip for Adarin & Guve seeds.
[/list]
Chill, relax and loot your way to victory!

notes.title: Adarin Farm will be out on the 21/01/2022
notes.content:
Hello Farmers!

Adarin Farm will be out in Early Access on the 21/01/2022!

[b][i]Patch v0.4.22.0114[/i][/b]

[b]Global notes[/b]

Game has been rebalanced from the feedback from the Playtest. Skills, seeds effect, field effects...

Seeds Effects have been totally revamped and are now applied as soon as a Seed is planted. Moreover, you are now able to choose between 5 randomized Seeds Effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/c3e06ef4071fbad183afc689cb6d23542cb4287f.png[/img]

Adarin Farm now has Unlocks to seek out. Every Star gathered now unlocks new parts of the game. 
More effects, more seeds, more affixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/7be0ce24fe5be06f3750f55002112312fbc0214f.png[/img]

A vendor has been added in order to exchange fertilizers for Buffs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41545582/a84c82762dffdade0398a3c6c53a2e104c01690e.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added sound and graphical effects when reaching a new milestones for stars.
[*] Increased the speed of radial menu opening to plant more fluently.
[*] Lowered price field on higher difficulties.
[*] Improved the display on tooltip for quantity & speed.
[*] Added all statistics in the tooltip when hovering over the number of seeds/fruits.
[*] Added an visual & audio effect for seed effect Fertilizer Durability.
[*] Added a highlight on Surrender Button when all stars are earned.
[*] Added a speed buff for the first 2 levels in order to make the barrier of entry easier.
[*] Added more warnings that assigning Skills reset the current run.
[*] Removed the default Pause by opening Stats or Skills.
[*] Added sound effect on Pause/Resume.
[*] On buying a field, all other field effects (not unlocked yet) are reset.
[*] Some screens are now available via keyboard for easier handling.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug while changing resolution: tooltip was sometimes not correctly aligned on the edge of the screen.
[*] Fixed a bug with radial menu for planting seeds. It should not display wrongly/not display anymore.
[*] Fixed a bug while 2 alerts were triggered at the exact same time, they were one over the other.
[*] Removed the tooltip when opening the Statistics panel.
[/list]

Relax, chill and loot your way to Victory!
